subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay intentionally override CDP’s omitted `Target.createTarget` foreground default so all OpenClaw automation-created tabs, including Playwright `newPage()`, open in the background?
rationale: Source, tests, live proof, and upstream contracts show the patch is technically coherent, but only an owner can decide whether user focus hygiene outweighs strict default compatibility for relay CDP clients.

options.title: Approve background automation default
options.body: Accept the intentional default deviation because OpenClaw selects automation targets by ID and explicit CDP foreground/focus requests remain preserved.

options.title: Preserve generic CDP defaults
options.body: Keep omitted relay requests foreground-compatible and add an OpenClaw-owned signal or narrower creation path for background automation.

options.title: Retain current foreground behavior
options.body: Decline the focus-hygiene change and leave incidental tab activation as the compatibility default.

recommendation.title: Approve background automation default
recommendation.body: Accept the intentional default deviation because OpenClaw selects automation targets by ID and explicit CDP foreground/focus requests remain preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the adjacent browser-focus contract merged through pull request https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100857.
